name: data-explorer
description: Shows the tables Claude Code runs into (query results, CSV, JSON and Excel files, tables in command output, tool results, web pages, replies and your messages) in a pane with sort, filter, grouping, data bars and copy

open.title: Open on a new table
open.description: on: the Data pane opens when Claude runs a query or reads a data file; in the terminal it shows once the window is at least 144 columns wide. off: tables still collect in the pane, which opens only when you run /data-explorer or Claude shows a file with its show_file tool.
